facts.quote: His success made the game popular, and newspapers began to report news about billiards.

facts.text: In 1983 Sunil Gavaskar broke the earlier record of maximum centuries in test cricket.

facts.text: In 1985 India won the 'Benson and Hedges' World Championship of cricket.
facts.quote: In 1985, India won the 'Benson and Hedges' World Championship of cricket.

facts.text: Cricket came to be played in all States, but at the cost of indigenous Indian games; movies were made on cricket and live telecasts became available.

facts.text: India had been participating in Asiad and Olympic games.

facts.quote: At the Olympics of year 2000, Karnam Malleshwari won a medal for weight-lifting. She was the first Indian woman to win a medal at the Olympics.

facts.text: India's representation began to rise in Olympic games such as hockey, badminton, tennis, swimming, weightlifting and archery.
facts.quote: India's representation began to rise in various Olympic games such as hockey, badminton, tennis, swimming, weightlifting and archery.

facts.text: Early plays were very long, sometimes running through an entire night; now form, technique and duration have changed and people from different walks of life take part.
facts.quote: Early plays were very long, sometimes running through an entire night. Now, the form, technique, duration of plays have all changed. People from different walks of life take part in the dramas.

facts.text: 'Musicals' have declined in importance; political and social subjects replaced the earlier mythological and historical themes.
facts.quote: But 'musicals' have now declined in importance and political and social subjects have replaced the earlier mythological and historical themes.

facts.text: Black and white movies were succeeded by coloured movies; the place of Hindi movies in entertainment is incomparable.
facts.quote: The age of black and white movies has been succeeded by the age of coloured movies. In the field of entertainment, the place of Hindi movies is incomparable.

facts.text: Movies now reflect contemporary themes, and shooting locales have moved abroad so viewers see places in foreign countries.
facts.quote: Now movies reflect contemporary themes. Film shooting locales have moved abroad. So, viewers can now see many different places in foreign countries.

facts.text: During English movies, a short Hindi translation appears on the screen as sub-titles.
facts.quote: During the screening of English movies, a short Hindi translation now appears on the screen as sub-titles.

facts.text: Movies which were 3-4 hours long are now only one or one and a half hours.
facts.quote: Movies which were 3-4 hours long are now of only one or one and a half hours.

facts.text: One screen and one cinema hall gave way to multiplexes; the days of a movie running 100 weeks in one hall are over; one movie runs in thousands of halls at once, changing the economy of movies.
facts.quote: Moreover, the concept of one screen and one cinema hall has given way to multiplexes. The days of a movie running for 100 weeks in one cinema hall are over. Now one movie runs in thousands of cinema halls in India and abroad simultaneously. This development has changed the economy of movies.

facts.text: Production of movies has attained the status of industry; the movie industry in regional languages is also thriving.
facts.quote: Production of movies has attained the status of industry. ... The movie industry in regional languages is also thriving.

facts.text: In the early post-independence period newspapers gave the news of daily events and gave impetus to industry and commerce by printing advertisements.
facts.quote: In this period, the newspapers were expected to not only give the news of daily events, but also give impetus to industry and commerce by printing advertisements.

facts.text: Newspapers aimed to shape public opinion, direct it towards constructive work, carry on public education and keep a watch over the government machinery.
facts.quote: Newspapers functioned with the following objectives : shape public opinon, direct it towards constructive work, at times lead the latter, carry on the task of public education, keep a watch over the government machinery, etc.

facts.text: Earlier newspapers were black and white; with changing times colour printing became common.
facts.quote: Earlier, newspapers were black and white. With the changing times, colour printing became common.

facts.text: Earlier newspapers were thought to be the mouthpieces of the taluka or district; now they face tough competition from State level newspaper chains.
facts.quote: Earlier, newspapers were thought to be the mouthpieces of the taluka or district. Now they have to face tough competition from the State level newspaper chains.

facts.text: Newspapers' scope has enlarged to raising funds for drought and flood affected people, helping meritorious students from lower income groups go for higher education, and cultural programmes.
facts.quote: Their scope has enlarged to include raising funds for drought affected and flood affected people, helping meritorious students from lower income groups to go for higher education and organizing or sponsoring cultural programmes.

facts.text: Television came to India during the post-independence period; earlier it was black and white, now coloured; earlier it had selected programmes and fixed time-slots.
facts.quote: Television came to India during the post-independence period. Earlier it was black and white. Now it is coloured. Earlier it was limited to some selected programmes and fixed time-slots.

facts.text: TV's scope grew to educational programmes, news bulletins and detailed reporting of the tours of the President and the Prime Minister.
facts.quote: Gradually its scope was enlarged to include educational programmes, news bulletins, detailed reporting of the tours of the President and the Prime Minister.

facts.text: During the telecast of Ramayana and Mahabharat most people sat glued to the TV; these serials proved the medium's popularity.
facts.quote: During the telelcast of Ramayana and Mahabharat, a majority of the people used to sit glued to the television set. These serials proved the popularity of this medium.

facts.text: In 1991 the CNN channel showed the entire world a live visual reporting of the Iraq war; the world of Indian news channels changed completely.
facts.quote: Then in 1991, CNN channel showed to the entire world a live visual reporting of the Iraq war. At this stage the world of Indian news channels changed completely.

facts.text: In 1998 STAR (Satellite Television Asia Region), a private media house, entered India, and the dull, propagandist news telecasts underwent a sea change.
facts.quote: In 1998, STAR (Satellite Television Asia Region) a private media house entered India, and the uninteresting, monotonous and propagandist news telecasts of the early period underwent a sea change.

facts.text: New language and presentation, modern studios and OB (outdoor broadcasting) vans expanded the scope of Indian T.V. channels and brought transparency and variety.
facts.quote: The language, the technique of presentation, studios equipped with the latest technology and the use of OB (outdoor broadcasting) vans have expanded the scope of Indian T.V. channels still further, and brought in transparency and variety.

facts.text: Every nook and corner of the country became connected, with a great impact on politics.
facts.quote: Now, every nook and corner of the country is connected. This has had a great impact on politics.
